question.text: Chapter IV of the SEBI (AIF) Regulations provides specific DISCLOSURE obligations to investors on:

answer.text: Conflict of interest, fund investments, fees, various risks, and valuation policy
Only the manager's personal net worth

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 11.3.6 references Chapter IV of SEBI (AIF) Regulations, which specifies disclosure obligations including conflict of interest, information on fund investments, fees, various risks and valuation policy. The Trap: The other options trivialise the scope of Chapter IV. Cross-Exam Context: Same disclosure ambit in XIX-C/D. XIX-A/B distributors test the same from a PPM-reading angle. Manager's Pro-Tip: Run a quarterly 'disclosure reconciliation' — compare your PPM, audited financials, IM, CTR, and investor statements to ensure consistent numbers on conflicts, fees (mgmt/perf/operating), concentration and valuation policy. Mismatches are a top SEBI-inspection finding.
